verdict.rationale: Edge0's own docs show it runs quantized models at 4-bit, using distilled LoRA adapters to recover the quantization loss. Nothing documents a choice of integer bit-widths from very-low-bit up to 8-bit. The ~2.5 GB RAM figure comes from SSD expert offload, a separate feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented support for multiple integer precisions (e.g. 2/3/8-bit), user-selectable quantization levels, memory-savings figures per bit-width, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision

citations.quote: LoRA adapters are trained by distillation from the FP teacher, recovering most of the quantization loss at 4-bit
